entities.name: Table T1 – MacroOptions Macro asset class implied volatility trends
entities.brief: Shows implied volatility ratios to historical average for five macro asset classes.

properties.key_insight: All asset classes spiked in implied volatility in early April 2025, with SPY peaking at 2.8× and HYG at 1.9× their historical averages, then declined to or below the long-term average by July 2025.
